description: Sanitized, non-secret completed-run artifacts of the one real measured experiment (run-20261006T142452Z, 1014 rows x 3 providers = 3042 row-provider pairs). These are byte-exact copies of the local gitignored run directory; they contain no API keys, authorization headers, or raw provider payloads, and let a fresh clone reproduce every published README metric and execute the offline notebook without any credentials.

provenance_notes.run.json: durable run header: identity, planned population, status, budget snapshot
provenance_notes.cases.jsonl: one terminal record per (row, provider): outcome, final vs gold label, per-attempt status/timing/usage/cost basis
provenance_notes.stages.jsonl: one entry per successful stage: validated choice, self-reported confidence/probabilities, usage
provenance_notes.shared_budget.json: final cumulative cross-phase $20 guard state (planning seed + preflight + pilots + measured runs); snapshot only
provenance_notes.preflight-20261005T182244Z.json: pre-repair planning preflight record kept for cost reconciliation only; it predates the durable shared-ledger format and the current frozen task wording (config fcc074a1...), so it is cost evidence, not run evidence
